event_feifei_daxia_teach.why: 菲菲捧著打開的秘笈擋在胸前，封面和畫招式的內頁都朝觀眾，她看的是背面；而且是舊畫風（蝴蝶結偏桃紅、腰間只有兩支米色細筒，不是一排金色針筒）。文字是樓梯間落著一本封面起毛的秘笈，菲菲翻開往後找了幾頁。
event_feifei_daxia_teach.scene: SETTING: a stairwell inside the tower - a few wide worn grey stone steps rising toward the back, on a small patch of cracked grey stone floor. Feifei sits on the second step, side-on to the viewer in a three-quarter view. On her knees she holds an OLD MARTIAL-ARTS MANUAL: a thick stitched book with a dark navy-blue cloth cover whose edges and corners are frayed and fuzzy (a few loose threads sticking out), with cream pages. The book is propped open on her knees and tilted up toward her face, its open pages facing HER, so the viewer sees only the worn navy-blue outside cover and the stitched spine - no pages and no drawings are visible to the viewer. Her LEFT paw holds the book by its spine; her RIGHT paw pinches the corner of a page and flips it over (a few page edges fanning), searching further back in the book. She looks down into the book with a curious, focused face, both blue eyes on the pages. Her purple bow, black scarf and the row of gold needle tubes at her black belt are all clearly visible.

event_feifei_daxia_teach_r0.why: 同主圖的錯：封面和內頁朝觀眾；文字說秘笈上有三幅圖，內頁只畫一幅。文字是菲菲攤開秘笈仔細看三幅圖，發現「手要這樣收」。
event_feifei_daxia_teach_r0.scene: SETTING: the same worn grey stone steps and cracked grey stone floor as in reference image 3. The SAME old manual as in reference image 3 (thick stitched book, dark navy-blue cloth cover with frayed fuzzy edges, cream pages) now lies OPEN and FLAT on the lowest stone step. Feifei kneels on the floor in the FOREGROUND in front of that step, on the near side of the book, seen in a three-quarter BACK view so the viewer looks over her shoulder: we see her back, her ponytail with the purple bow, her tail, and her face turned in profile. The book is turned the right way up for her (its top edge points away from her, into the picture), so the viewer also sees the two open pages the right way up, and her body does not hide them. The open pages show exactly THREE small ink drawings in a row of a little cat throwing a thin needle: 1) arm drawn back holding a needle, 2) arm flicking forward releasing the needle, 3) the paw pulled back in close to the chest with a small curved arrow showing how the hand returns (ink pictures only, no writing). Feifei leans over the book studying the third drawing: the tip of her LEFT paw touches that drawing, and she copies it with her RIGHT paw, pulling it back in close to her chest, eyes on the page, with a small 'I see!' look of realisation. Her purple bow, black scarf and the row of gold needle tubes at her black belt are visible.

event_feifei_sunbath_r1.scene: SETTING: the same corner of dark wooden floorboards as in reference image 3: two low wooden plank walls meeting at the back corner, a narrow window shutter standing slightly open in the right-hand wall, and a warm golden beam of sunlight falling through the gap onto the floor, making a bright patch of light. Feifei sits relaxed inside the sunny patch in the FOREGROUND, seen in a three-quarter BACK view from behind and slightly to the left, so the viewer looks over her shoulder: we see her back, her ponytail with the purple bow, her tail curled around her, and her face in profile, eyes half-closed and warm in the sun. Her black scarf and the row of gold needle tubes at her black belt are visible.

event_feifei_pigeon_grandpa_r0.scene: SETTING: the same small attic as in reference image 3 (dark wooden floorboards, sloping wooden roof beams, a round window showing the night moon, a glowing paper lantern with a paw print, stacked old wooden crates and boxes, an open trapdoor in the floor). Feifei sits on the floor right beside the OLD GRANDPA CAT from reference image 3 (brown tabby, round wire glasses, bushy white eyebrows, patched olive-green jacket, grey knitted scarf); both face the viewer in a three-quarter view. Feifei holds the letter - ONE single sheet of paper - up in front of her chest with both paws and reads it aloud. The written side of the letter faces FEIFEI (her eyes look down into it), so the viewer sees only the PLAIN BLANK BACK of the sheet: no drawing, no bow, no fruit, no marks at all on the side facing the viewer. The old cat leans in close at her side, listening with a soft, moved face, and gently pats the back of her paw with one of his paws. No pigeon in this picture. Her purple bow, black scarf and the row of gold needle tubes at her black belt are visible.

event_feifei_cell_bandit_r0.scene: SETTING: the same dungeon corner as in reference image 3: a patch of rough stone floor with a little rubble, a rough stone wall with a lit wall torch and a treasure map scratched into the stone, rusty iron bars with the cell door now swung OPEN and the old rusty padlock hanging open from it. Feifei KNEELS INSIDE the flattened hollow, in its middle, in the FOREGROUND, seen from BEHIND in a three-quarter back view (from behind and slightly to the left): we see her back, her ponytail with the purple bow, her tail, and her face turned in profile. Feifei practises that grip: her RIGHT paw is raised, pinching one thin gold needle the same way, the fingers trembling (small shake lines); a tiny red dot shows on the back of her LEFT paw where the needle has just pricked her. Gritted teeth in her profile, a sweat drop, eyes on the paper - hurting but determined. Her black scarf and the row of gold needle tubes at her black belt are visible.
